question: Who among the following established the Academy of Performing Arts and Research in Switzerland?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. M Balamuralikrishna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dr. M Balamuralikrishna was a renowned Indian Carnatic vocalist, multi-instrumentalist, playback singer, and composer.
 
• He established the Academy of Performing Arts and Research in Switzerland to promote Indian classical music internationally.
 
• Dr. Balamuralikrishna's contributions to music have been recognized globally, and he has received numerous awards, including the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award.
 
• The Academy in Switzerland focuses on providing high-quality training in various forms of Indian classical music and performing arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carnatic Music**:

 
 
• Carnatic music is a system of music commonly associated with the southern part of the Indian subcontinent, with its classical traditions rooted in the Vedas.
 
• It is characterized by a rich tradition of compositions (kriti) and improvisations (manodharma).
 
• Key elements include ragas (melodic frameworks) and talas (rhythmic cycles).
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**:
 
 
• Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, categorized into Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• They are awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in various fields, including the arts, science, and public affairs.
 
 
 
• **Indian Classical Music Institutions**:
 
 
• Several institutions in India and abroad promote Indian classical music, including the Sangeet Natak Akademi and the ITC Sangeet Research Academy.
 
• These institutions offer training, conduct research, and organize performances to preserve and propagate classical music traditions.
 
 
 
• **Global Influence of Indian Classical Music**:
 
 
• Indian classical music has influenced many global music genres and has been embraced by international audiences.
 
• Renowned artists like Ravi Shankar and L. Subramaniam have played pivotal roles in popularizing Indian classical music worldwide.
